title: Final Examination
description: The final test of the whole course; one long, honest passage that asks for everything you have practiced.

exercises.instruction: Type it once, calmly, as a final proof of everything you have learned.
exercises.text: Success is not built in a single day. It is the sum of many small, honest efforts repeated with care. A writer practices every page, a runner trains every mile, and a typist trains every key. Now that you have reached this lesson, you have already learned the most important secret: steady daily practice turns a beginner into an expert.
